name: The Moonsilver Blade
label: Quest
description: The Moonsilver Blade: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here's the blade. You said that an adventurer named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Was Ott able to carry out the commission?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This will do nicely, friend. I knew that Ott had it in him to make something truly great.
The only thing left now is to kill that beast. Speak with Lumina when you are ready.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
